_comment: Deterministic resource budgets for scripts/bench/check_budgets.py. Binary sizes are measured release builds (Cargo.toml [profile.release]) plus binary_headroom_pct. Memory ceilings are generous: only a leak or an unbounded buffer should exceed them on any runner. Update the sizes deliberately when a change is expected to grow a binary. Linux sizes measured with Rust 1.98 (rust:1.98-bookworm); macOS with Rust 1.90. M2 (agent capture): tailflow +12.0 % (hook bridge links the privacy/redaction engine the TUI never called) and tailflow-daemon +8.1 % (sessions, spool ingestion, notify); macOS measured, Linux scaled by the same ratios.
